subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The speaker requested the audience to pay ________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**attention**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**attention**" means the act of listening carefully or focusing on something. (ध्यान)
 
• The speaker requested the audience to pay attention, which means to carefully listen to what is being said.
 
• The other options: "**ears**," "**silence**," and "**alertness**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The speaker requested the audience to pay attention__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ears (कान)**: refers to the organs used for hearing, but the phrase "pay ears" is incorrect.
 
• **Silence (शांति)**: means the absence of sound, but it does not fit the context of "pay."
 
• **Alertness (सतर्कता)**: means being aware or vigilant, but it is not used with the verb "pay" in this context.
